purpose: Identify, observe and verify one technical database asset as the subject of a programming repair, without presenting it as a screen.

observed_state.reader: SECURITY INVOKER, STABLE, fixed search_path, read-only catalog readback
observed_state.attrs_sha256: sha256 of {owner, language, security_definer, volatility, config, returns}
observed_state.acl: aclexplode(coalesce(proacl, acldefault('f', proowner))) sorted by grantee then privilege; PUBLIC spelled PUBLIC
observed_state.acl_sha256: sha256 of the normalized acl array
observed_state.effective_privileges: has_function_privilege per role listed in the delta; required in success criteria because the ACL text does not include inherited grants

source_pin.known_parity_gap: Hosted prosrc can differ from the Git migration bytes (observed 2026-10-27 for fn_lf_decision_context_asof_record_v1: equal only modulo whitespace). Byte parity is a finding, not an admission blocker, until the owner decides the rule.

success_criteria_examples: effective EXECUTE false for anon and authenticated
definition.approval: PENDING_DECISION: who approves a technical delta and how the approval binds to the subject sha

currentness.reuse: CURRENTNESS_AUTHORITY vocabulary; no new snapshot table

admission_evolution.proposal: Next admission version discriminated by definition_kind in {SCREEN, TECHNICAL_ASSET}; one kind per envelope in its first version; each kind with its own provider and its own selection binding

transport: ACTUALIZACION_DB_LF -> PR -> PASE -> Merge Train; the repair itself never writes hosted state
